description: This is an entry point JavaScript file for a React-based web application. It imports React and ReactDOM libraries, alongside local CSS and App component, then initializes and renders the React application into the DOM element with id 'root'.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the application.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React application within the specified DOM element.
